newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: PDVSA awaiting Brazil's word on joint refinery.
newsitem.headline: PDVSA awaiting Brazil's word on joint refinery.

text.p: Venezuela's state oil company Petroleos de Venezuela (PDVSA) is waiting for a decision from the Brazilian government and state-run Petrobras on plans to build a joint refinery, a top PDVSA official said Wednesday.
"We have made an offer to participate and it's in their hands," PDVSA vice-President Claus Graf told reporters at a breakfast meeting.

Graf said PDVSA was looking to take a very small stake in the refinery of about five percent and would supply up to 100,000 barrels per day of crude for processing. He gave no capacity for the refinery.
PDVSA and Petrobras have been discussing the refinery project, to be built in northeastern Brazil, for over a year.
